name: X-linked Intellectual Disability-Ataxia-Apraxia Syndrome
aliases: X-linked ID with Ataxia and Apraxia

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed Clinical Diagnostic Criteria for XLID-Ataxia-Apraxia Syndrome

criteria.description: Presence of moderate to severe intellectual disability
Clinical evidence of cerebellar ataxia including gait and limb incoordination
Demonstrated limb apraxia affecting purposeful movements
X-linked inheritance pattern or affected male relatives
Pathogenic variant in the implicated gene on the X chromosome

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of intellectual disability, cerebellar ataxia, and limb apraxia with either family history consistent with X-linked inheritance or genetic confirmation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is recommended to confirm diagnosis and exclude phenocopies.

laboratory: Possible mild elevation of lactate in some cases
genetic: Pathogenic variants in X-linked gene associated with intellectual disability and ataxia (specific gene varies)
other: Electroencephalogram (EEG) may show nonspecific slowing or epileptiform discharges

redFlags: Onset of seizures refractory to treatment
Signs of multisystem involvement beyond typical phenotype
references: Orphanet: X-linked intellectual disability-ataxia-apraxia syndrome, ORPHA:85338
Recent literature on X-linked ataxia and intellectual disability syndromes
